summary: acer nitro 16 gaming experiencing crashes and blue screens when running high-performance games like Beaming or Elden Ring, with no apparent overheating issues.
detected_fault: Potential conflict between NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 drivers (460.x or later) and Intel Core i7-11800H BIOS (F30x or later), causing system instability and crashes.
suggested_solution: Update NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 drivers to the latest version (460.x or later) and check for any BIOS updates, installing the latest version (F30x or later).
